title: The kb-autopilot tick runs kbdecide.py digest and list, PushNotification and ToolSearch, which settings.json does not allow, so an unattended loop stalls on a permission prompt
goal: .claude/settings.json allows exactly `kbdecide.py digest` and `kbdecide.py list` (read-only forms, Bash and PowerShell), PushNotification and ToolSearch, and nothing wider; test_settings_allow asserts each allow and that no wider kbdecide form (record, ratify, revert, supersede, invalidate) is allowed; found by the SP-4xngzagf review; the operator approved the PushNotification and ToolSearch rules

run: import json,sys;a=json.load(open(".claude/settings.json"))["permissions"]["allow"];need=["Bash(python3 _tools/kbdecide.py digest)","Bash(python3 _tools/kbdecide.py list *)","PushNotification","ToolSearch"];miss=[n for n in need if n not in a];print(miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

repro_reason: a permission decision is made by Claude Code when a tool call is attempted and no repro here can run one; the defect is the allow list of the configuration, so the repro reads it
